_provenance.note: Florida citation authorities. The ACCESS Florida Program Policy Manual cites passages by chapter.program.section, e.g. '2410.0344' — the '10' in the middle two digits of the chapter marks it Food Stamps (FS); '20' would be TCA, '30' MFAM, etc. Cited here as 'FS <passage>' to disambiguate from the same numeric passage under a different program, matching how this pack's own text distinguishes them (e.g. every FS passage title ends '(FS)' in the source itself). Florida Administrative Code rules are cited 'F.A.C. 65A-1.NNN'; statutes as 'Fla. Stat. § NNN.NNN'.
